name: u01-remaining-routine-validate-precert
title: Require a PRE_CERT window before TEST-admissible routine validate so REVIEW cannot rerun the full suite
description: Close the remaining U-01 slice that B-1e1f and B-3f3d do not cover: treat this repo’s TEST-admissible routine `proof-or-stop validate --story` (the serial `validate.commands` suite, no --full) and `story_advance --phase=TEST`’s `runValidateGate` as official heavy certification. Refuse those entries unless a current CertificationWindow is ADMITTED or RUNNING. Keep review preflight slices and focused smokes outside the window. After B-3f3d, admit must consume a saturated review-inventory receipt rather than a completeness-only stub. Prove a B-cc10-shaped REVIEW loop cannot spawn the suite, and that one admitted window runs the suite at most once.
